newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Banco Latino sale waits agency approval.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Banco Latino sale waits agency approval.

text.p: The postponed sale of Venezuela's Arfinan bank, created from the restructuring of state-owned Banco Latino, will go ahead once the national banking superintendency rules that it can operate as a commercial bank, state deposits guarantee fund Fogade said.
"We're waiting for the superintendency's decision," Fogade President Esther de Margulis told reporters without providing greater details.
Arfinan was originally slated for a December 19 sale at a base price of 22 billion bolivars ($47 million).
Directors at Banco Latino, whose collapse in January 1994 sparked an unprecedented banking crisis, have said Arfinan would be sold in late January -- but the date has not been confirmed by Fogade.
